title: Training planning – Kaderblick documentation

hero.heading: Plan and run training
hero.lead: From the calendar event to the session plan, mobile delivery and review.

body:
Open planning from a training event

Training planning extends the existing calendar event. Open a training in Calendar and select Plan training or Open plan.

The header always shows team, date, time and venue. Check this context before editing. The action is only available when you may edit that event.

Create a draft

  1. Enter a focus and, if useful, a more precise objective.
  2. Add blocks with title, duration and instructions.
  3. Duplicate, remove or reorder blocks with the visible actions.
  4. Add equipment and quantities in the equipment section.
  5. Compare total planned time with the calendar event duration.
  6. Select Save draft; a draft may still be incomplete.

Use templates

A team template copies its sequence and equipment into the selected session. The copy is independent: later changes do not affect the template or other sessions. Available actions let you save a plan as a template, rename templates or archive them.

Prepare and run the session

A focus and at least one block are required before marking a session ready. When planned time differs from the event duration, Kaderblick shows the difference and requests confirmation.

  1. Open Run on the training.
  2. Work through the blocks in order.
  3. Mark completed blocks and add a short deviation note if needed.
  4. Use Previous and Next; progress remains after reloading.
  5. Complete the session deliberately and add the internal review.

Complete, reopen and troubleshoot

The summary separates planned, completed and skipped blocks. A completed session can be reopened after confirmation and saved as a reusable template.

  • If a plan is missing, check team, event type and your edit permission.
  • For a version conflict, load the current state and reapply the change deliberately.
  • For cancelled or deleted events, check the calendar status.
  • Templates belong to an authorised team and sport; archived templates are not offered normally.
